turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm trying to pick a way to budget because I keep running out of money before payday.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me describe all the options before you comment.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: One method is tracking every single purchase in a spreadsheet, which is detailed but takes time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Another one is the envelope method, where I take out cash for each category every week.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Or I could use a budgeting app that connects to my bank and sorts everything automatically.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's the full list. Go ahead.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: The app is the easiest to stick with, since it does the sorting for you. The envelope method is great if you overspend with cards, because you can see the cash running out. The spreadsheet gives the most detail, but it's easy to fall behind on.
